name: Azazel
source:
Main character loses after an accident two years ago. Life goes on peacefully till he notices a  shadow of a woman with a gun followed by receiving an injection. All his senses improve immensely, but so do his desires. Standing in a pool of blood he hears her say: "Finally your powers have been unsealed".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
兩年前的一場事故讓主角失去了某樣重要事物。生活一直平靜地繼續，直到他看見一名持槍女性的身影，隨後又被注射了某種藥物。他的所有感官都得到驚人強化，慾望也隨之暴漲。站在血泊中的他聽見女人說道：「你的力量終於解封了。」

[譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
